title: docs(releases): fold #25563, #25564, #25565 and #25560 into the 18.1.0 notes
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiRwWtsarkLPmw9fMYiFZ3LY)_

## Summary

Five more changesets reached `main` after #25562 was compiled at `03243fc637`, still before the 18.1.0 cut. This PR folds them into the 18.1.0 notes. It is docs-only.

Three are breaking patches:
- **#25563, auth secret**: the temporary auth secret is now used on a development or test boot only. This goes under "Boot and deployment", and checklist step 2 now names the embedded-kernel case.
- **#25563, window functions**: `findWithWindowFunctions()` now serves a closed set of functions and directions. This goes under "Datasources and drivers".
- **#25565**: a REST credential is honoured only in the environment that validated it. This goes under "REST, MCP and API clients", and checklist step 4 covers multi-environment hosts.

The other two:
- **#25564** is semantic: it records the change of meaning that #25483 made to `runAs`. It goes under "Semantic changes".
- **#25560** is a fix and is counted under other fixes.

The counts are now 258 entries, split 81 / 9 / 47 / 3 / 118. 90 changesets are declared breaking, 48 `minor` and 42 `patch`, and `check-adr-0087-registration --list` reports 90 of 90. The count is updated on the 18.1 page, the v18 index, the releases index and Backward Compatibility.

## Checks

These pass locally: `check:role-word`, `check:release-notes`, `check:release-page-status`, `check:release-index-currency-sync`, `check:doc-anchors`, `check:docs-audit-scope`, `check:docs-single-h1`, and an MDX compile of the page.
